name: Timer Resolution
description: Sets the Windows timer resolution (like TimerResolution.exe) from inside the game, for lower frame-pacing jitter and input latency.

resolution.name: Resolution (ms)
resolution.description: Requested timer resolution in milliseconds. Windows clamps it to the lowest value the system supports (usually 0.5 ms).

ignore-throttling.name: Keep resolution when minimized (Win 11)
ignore-throttling.description: Opts the process out of Windows power throttling of the timer resolution, so it stays applied when the window is minimized or occluded.
